findings.derivatives: Long liquidations are approximately 94% of reported liquidations and open interest is down 4.5% over 24 hours. This is consistent with leveraged-long deleveraging, not a directional forecast. Aggregate funding is slightly negative while Binance funding is positive, so venue divergence must remain explicit.
findings.etf_flows: All three trackers report positive October 29 flow direction, but their coverage differs. Alpha reports 5-of-5 funds; CryptoETF.today reports only 2-of-5; XRP Insights reports XRP units across six spot funds plus BITW. Preserve separate provider observations and do not sum them.
findings.binance: Binance's preliminary company statement estimates total incident impact at $6.3B and approximately $3B in frozen assets. Frozen does not mean recovered. The earlier 233.4619431M XRP transfer from five Binance-labelled XRPL accounts remains a potential overhang only; no sale was established in the prior receiver capture.
findings.binance_japan: Binance Japan says customer assets are in cold wallets separate from Binance Global hot wallets and no Japan-entity impact was confirmed. This is a company statement, not an independent reserve audit, and cannot be generalized to Binance Global.
findings.ask_coin: Permission confirms Coinbase Embedded Wallet powers its ASK wallet and Coinbase secures user private keys under user authority. Permission lists official ASK contracts on Base and Polygon using LayerZero OFT-20; no official XRPL contract is listed. Permission describes subscription-funded ASK buybacks, but executed buybacks were not verified.
findings.ask_supply: CoinGecko and CoinMarketCap circulating-supply estimates differ materially; issuer API retrieval was not completed. Do not use either circulating figure for valuation or float calculations.
findings.sbic: Two separate meanings are confirmed: SBIC East Japan, a Japanese SME investment corporation, and the Social Bias Inference Corpus used in a GPT-3.5/GPT-4 evaluation. Table 7's 65.9%/60.6% figures are pairwise human preference rates, not accuracy. The Japanese corporation and dataset have no established organizational relationship.
findings.coinbase_circle_ripple_context: Carry-forward: Coinbase remains an exchange, USDC distribution partner with Circle, cbXRP reserve custodian, RLUSD distribution venue and now Permission ASK embedded-wallet infrastructure provider. These are separate relationships; the Permission ASK wallet does not establish XRP integration. Circle's USDC on XRPL and its Coinbase distribution relationship remain separate from Permission's ASK deployment.
findings.prediction_engine: No directional forecast issued. The derivatives and ETF observations are not admitted as model features until venue/fund coverage, point-in-time availability and historical completeness are reconciled.
